bosses.name: Cherubim
bosses.strategy:
Ah, Brain Hopper; I miss this music. In any case, Cherubim will usually
start the battle with the !!! attack, reducing a party member's HP to 1,
or Divine Punishment, doing pretty good damage to your entire party, as
well as causing various status effects, so make sure to heal them
straight away. He will continue using them throughout the battle, and his
physical attacks will hit an ally for pretty decent damage as well.
Note that he won't take hardly any damage from your special attacks, so
focus only on physical attacks. Have Yuri fuse into Amon and attack
normally while Alice casts Arc as needed, leaving Margarete to also
attack normally, supporting Alice when needed to replenish Yuri's SP, as
well as Alice's MP.
Cherubim isn't really that complicated, so as long as you have Crucifixes
equipped to everyone and have Alice use Arc every round, then it's just a
matter of taking the time to whittle away his HP. Just make sure not to
let anyone go Berserk.
NOTE     Once the battle is over, you'll receive Zhuzhen's best weapon,
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   the Holy Peak Staff.

  NOTE     The boss here absorbs special attacks, so make sure that you bring
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   two fighters with Mind's Eyes equipped, and have Alice to heal. As
           always, I'm taking Yuri, Alice, and Margarete.

Start walking west and head through the arches to be inside the temple. Make
your way northeast and through the door here, and you'll arrive inside the
maze. It's very easy to get lost in here, so follow along carefully. Each room
has three doors: north, west, and east, and they all look exactly alike. To get
all of the treasures, and to get through the maze, take the following paths
from the first room inside the maze:

 - NORTH, opening the chest here for some [_PRIEST EARRINGS_].
 - SOUTH, back to the first room.
 - WEST.
 - NORTH.
 - WEST.
 - SOUTH.
 - SOUTH.
 - WEST.
 - NORTH, opening the chest here for a [_LOTTERY TICKET_].
 - SOUTH, back to the previous room.
 - WEST.
 - NORTH.
 - WEST, to a Save Point.
 - NORTH, where you'll find Keith's best armor, the [_MANT.OFSHIVERING_].

You'll be back at the entrance after opening the chest. Examine the Emigre
Manuscript once again, which has actually changed in both description and
fragrance. By re-examining it, it will change the maze inside.

Re-enter the maze once again. The path is very similar to the previous path,
but for all paths where you needed to go west, you now need to go east.

 - NORTH, opening the chest here for a [_FIFTH KEY_].
 - SOUTH, back to the first room.
 - EAST.
 - NORTH.
 - EAST.
 - SOUTH.
 - SOUTH.
 - EAST.
 - NORTH, opening the chest here for a [_KEY TO SUCCESS_].
 - SOUTH, back to the previous room.
 - EAST.
 - NORTH.
 - EAST, to a Save Point.

Use the Save Point. Make sure you have Crucifixes equipped, then when you're
ready, head north to take on Cherubim.

outside and out to the World Map. Let's take on the next area.
